rules: A price is never taken from a model's memory. It is read from the provider's published pricing and recorded here with its source and the timestamp of the check.

Every entry carries a `confidence`. `verified` means this build read the provider's own pricing page. `secondary` means the figure came from a cached table or a third-party source and has NOT been confirmed against the provider.
A `secondary` price may be used to produce an estimate, and the estimate must be labelled as resting on an unverified price (REQ-COST-04).
Re-validate at gate G2 alongside versions/manifest.json. A pricing file older than staleAfterDays makes every money column an estimate.
Token counts are measured and are never estimated. Money is derived. The cost table never presents one as the other.

egressNote: docs.claude.com returned 302 and both www.anthropic.com/pricing and dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits were unreachable (curl exit, no HTTP status) through this environment's proxy on 2026-09-21. Nothing below is marked `verified` for that reason. Do not silently upgrade a confidence level without a successful fetch.

anthropic.provenance: Bundled claude-api skill's cached model table, dated 2026-06-24. Not confirmed against the live pricing page this build.

claude-opus-5.note: Default build model. Fast mode is billed at 10.00/50.00 and is a separate decision.

claude-sonnet-5.note: Sensible worker-tier model for a reading-heavy subagent.

batch.note: Batch API runs asynchronously at half price. Not usable for an interactive wave, usable for bulk analysis.

cacheRead.note: Cache reads are priced below fresh input and are the main lever this structure controls. Where a model's cache-read rate is not recorded above, report the token count and mark the money cell as incomplete rather than assuming a ratio (REQ-COST-12).

meta.provenance: Web search snippets citing dev.meta.ai and third-party pricing write-ups, retrieved 2026-09-21. Meta's own hosts (dev.meta.ai, developer.meta.com) are blocked by this environment's egress proxy, so nothing here was read from the vendor. Confirm every figure and the active tier before deriving money.

muse-spark-1.3.note: Figures quoted for the xhigh tier on the standard endpoint. Confirm the tier matches how the build actually runs before deriving money from this.

muse-spark-1.3-contributor.warning: Meta may use prompts and outputs from this tier to improve its products. REQ-PORT-08: running this build on the contributor tier is an explicitly recorded decision, because the build handles security posture, credential guidance and compliance evidence. Roughly 10-20x cheaper is not a reason on its own.
muse-spark-1.3-contributor.defaultTierWarning: Multiple secondary sources report that Muse Code DEFAULTS to the contributor tier after install, so opting out is an active step the operator must take rather than a choice they are offered. Marked unconfirmed - verify before the first build with `cat ~/.config/muse/settings.json` and by checking which model id the session actually reports. If it is true, a build run on a fresh install has already sent its prompts to a training-eligible tier, and REQ-PORT-08's recorded decision must be made BEFORE the first run, not after.
